kind: complete proof candidate for the sole original target
statement: For every complex terminal Calabi–Yau fibre space f:(X,Δ)→S in the sense of Li–Zhao (2025), with X normal projective Q-factorial, K_X+Δ relatively numerically trivial, and relative dimension 0, 1 or 2, the faithful numerical image Γ of the relative support-preserving pseudo-automorphism group admits a rational polyhedral cone Π in C=closed Mov(X/S) intersect Eff(X/S) with ΓΠ=C, γΠ disjoint from Int(Π) for every γ other than the identity, and trivial setwise stabilizer. Total dimension is unrestricted, and no base Q-factoriality or nondegeneracy of the closed movable cone is imposed.
